exposure: Use of intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) before pregnancy
cohort: 421 singleton births at the University of Gondar comprehensive specialized hospital
finding: Advanced maternal age, primiparity, maternal chronic hypertension, previous cesarean delivery, and use of IUCD before pregnancy were independently associated with an increased risk of anomalous cord insertion.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of anomalous cord insertion.
